activating .]] Talent Arts are a kind of Vanguard Art in Torna ~ The Golden Country. Each playable character has a unique Talent Art which cannot be upgraded. They are performed by pressing right on the D-pad. Talent Arts are unlike normal attacks. Each has a particular condition which must be met to be used, and they seldom deal direct damage as a primary effect. Internally, they each work by applying a unique buff or debuff.

TWOFIVE Inc. (stylised in the Xenosaga: Pied Piper credits as TWO FIVE) is a Japanese soundtrack company. They provide services such as voice recording, sound effects, and music production. They, and specifically the staff members Kousei Muraki and Tomokazu Ushiyama, produced the music and sound effects for Xenosaga: Pied Piper.

Ultimate Qigong is a in Xenoblade Chronicles 3. It belongs to the Thaumaturge , and becomes a when reaching rank 5 in this class. It has the user deal damage to targets as if their were additively lower than its actual value. As an example, attacking an enemy with 40% physical defense with the rank 1 version of the skill (-30%) will deal damage as though their physical defense were 10%, and attacking an enemy with 20% physical defense with the rank 20 version of the skill (-50%) deals damage as though their physical defense were -30%.
